title: Causal Attribution for Agentic Decisions: Estimators, Coupling, and a Traceability Specification
abstract: arXiv:2609.06445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A provider of a high-risk AI system must keep records that make a decision traceable, and for agentic systems it has not been established what those records must contain for post-hoc causal attribution to be possible. We give the estimator framework and then the conditions under which it fails. We separate the marginal total effect that prior work measures from a common-random-numbers total effect that isolates a step's own contribution, add the natural direct effect under a pinned downstream, and check the estimators against hand derivations. Both estimands then fail, in the same direction. Under the marginal estimand a causally inert step has the identical total effect to the decisive one on every run of our planted chain, an algebraic identity and not a coincidence at one draw. Under common random numbers the decisive step returns exactly zero on the runs where the executing step flips, about one in ten, while its direct effect there

translated_title: 智能体决策的因果归因：估计量、耦合与可追溯性规范
translated_abstract: 高风险AI系统的提供者必须保存能够使决策可追溯的记录，而对于智能体系统，尚未确定这些记录必须包含哪些内容才能使事后因果归因成为可能。我们给出了估计量框架，并阐述了其失效的条件。我们将先前工作所测量的边际总效应与能够隔离某一环节自身贡献的共同随机数总效应区分开来，增加了下游被固定条件下的自然直接效应，并将估计量与手工推导进行了核对。随后两个估计目标都以相同的方向失效。在边际估计目标下，在我们的植入链条的每一次运行中，因果惰性环节的总效应与决定性环节完全相同，这是一个代数恒等式，而非单次抽样中的巧合。在共同随机数下，决定性环节在执行环节发生翻转的运行中（约占十分之一）恰好返回零，而其直接效应在该处……（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了智能体决策因果归因的估计量框架，证明了边际总效应和共同随机数总效应两类估计目标均会以相同方式失效——因果惰性环节与决定性环节产生不可区分的效应——并给出了使事后因果归因成为可能所需的决策记录可追溯性规范。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an estimator framework for causal attribution of agentic decisions, demonstrates that both marginal and common-random-numbers total effect estimands fail in the same direction—making causally inert steps indistinguishable from decisive ones—and provides a traceability specification for the records required to enable post-hoc causal attribution.
